interaction_rules.message: Avoid routine proton-pump inhibitor co-administration with erlotinib. Omeprazole reduced erlotinib AUC by 46% and Cmax by 61% in the SmPC interaction study. If acid suppression is essential, review the current SmPC and oncology-pharmacy advice rather than automatically substituting another acid-suppressing medicine.

Review all medicines before capecitabine. Coumarin anticoagulants such as warfarin require close INR monitoring; monitor phenytoin concentrations when co-prescribed. Avoid allopurinol and review folic/folinic-acid supplements. Brivudine is contraindicated with capecitabine: allow at least four weeks after brivudine before starting capecitabine. This is a targeted prompt, not a complete interaction screen.

Do not combine panitumumab with bevacizumab-containing chemotherapy or IFL. Review EGFR skin care, magnesium/calcium/potassium monitoring through eight weeks after treatment and all concomitant medicines. Combination chemotherapy adds its own interaction checks.

Confirm cetuximab premedication and one-hour interval before chemotherapy. Review skin care, electrolyte replacement and all concomitant medicines. Current EMA information includes fortnightly dosing; reconcile older NCCP unlicensed-schedule footnotes with pharmacy.

Review CYP3A inhibitors/inducers, all medicines and supplements, UGT1A1 risk and atropine suitability. Provide a separate delayed-diarrhoea plan. This targeted reminder is not a complete interaction screen.
Review warfarin/INR, phenytoin and DPD-inhibiting medicines. Brivudine/sorivudine combinations are contraindicated; confirm required washout using the current SmPC and pharmacy.
